title: Order of Operations
questionReadAloudEn: How do you solve a math problem with more than one operation? Example: parentheses, three minus one, times five, plus twelve divided by four.
answerReadAloudEn: Use the order of operations: PEMDAS. Parentheses, exponents, multiplication or division from left to right, addition or subtraction from left to right.

title: Powers of Ten
questionReadAloudEn: What does ten to the third power mean?
answerReadAloudEn: Ten to the third power means that ten is being multiplied by itself three times. Ten times ten times ten equals one thousand.

title: Common Conversions
questionReadAloudEn: One foot equals how many inches? One yard equals how many feet? One pound equals how many ounces? One liter equals how many milliliters?
answerReadAloudEn: One foot equals twelve inches. One yard equals three feet. One pound equals sixteen ounces. One liter equals one thousand milliliters.
